Close other WiView connections. If pairing has expired, forget the back in system Bluetooth settings and pair again. For old firmware, try insecure RFCOMM in Settings.
Connect to the back and complete synchronization first

Connection and photo reading were reported working on Valeo 22Wi and Aptus 22. New control writes still need hardware checks; firmware and phone details were not supplied.

JPEG sample warning: highlight ≥250 / largest shadow channel ≤5. This is not a RAW exposure measurement.
Follows the system by default; other system languages use English. Changing language preserves the session, photos and zoom position.
Back marks, processed previews and pixel inspection are implemented from static protocol evidence. New writes and coordinate mapping still need hardware validation.
Nearby devices permission has not been granted
Nearby devices permission is needed to discover and connect to the back. You can grant it in system app settings.
Nearby devices permission was revoked. Grant permission and reconnect.
No photos yet. Connect and refresh back folders, or open the offline demo on the Capture page.
No verified continuous sensor-stream interface has been found. Post-capture automatic display is a separate feature.
Off by default. Reconnect after changing this. Android manages pairing.
Offline demo: no back is connected. This generated image is only for testing zoom, histograms, flags and interface state.
Older cached previews are removed when space is needed. Local flags and notes are retained.
Only while a Bluetooth session is active
Pairing did not complete or has expired. Forget the old pairing in system Bluetooth settings and pair again.
Phone Bluetooth has been turned off
Preview attachments and MOS originals are separate. This page has not read RAW pixels.
Standard SPP, startup sync, JPEG requests and capture notifications are implemented. Aptus / Valeo hardware testing is still pending.
Stars and local notes are saved on the phone. They do not automatically change the back.
Synchronization complete. Release the technical camera shutter manually; capture notifications will request previews automatically.
System pairing did not start. Use system Bluetooth settings.
Tap to read preview from the back
The attachment is not a decodable preview. It has not been saved as a MOS original.
The back acknowledged the note write. Read photo information again to verify it.
The back enabled an unverified packetized size mode. Export diagnostics.
The back is processing the photo. Waiting for a saved-image notification.
The back reported capture error %1$s. Its preview was not requested.
The cached preview cannot be decoded. Read it again.
The corresponding original commands are implemented. A note write is reported as acknowledged only after the back replies. Target firmware testing is pending.
The displayed image was reduced to limit memory use. The cache still preserves the complete received preview bytes.
The original client uses the PDA system code page. ASCII filenames work independently; non-ASCII text requires hardware verification.
The preview queue is full. Refresh the selected photo later.
The technical camera mechanical shutter must be released manually. This setup has no app-controlled shutter actuator.
This device has no Bluetooth adapter
This device has no Bluetooth adapter. You can use the offline demo to inspect the interface.
This preview is not cached. Connect to the back and read it again.
Uses actual preview pixels. Histograms come from JPEG data; local flags and notes are stored on the phone.
Waiting for system Bluetooth connection and pairing

Writing to the back uses the original WiView SetPictureParams command. Special characters and non-ASCII encoding still need hardware verification. Read the photo information again to check the result.
Read the back first. ISO and image settings affect later captures. Release the mechanical shutter manually.
Connect to read the settings and choices supplied by this back.
No complete active ShootSetup was supplied. Legacy configuration writes stay disabled; refresh the back or export diagnostics.
Missing settings: %1$s. A partial setup will not be sent.
Choices come from this back. A setting without an advertised choice list stays read-only. Other setup fields are preserved.
Reported shutter speed: %1$s (read-only; no mechanical shutter control).
Changes cannot be safely encoded, or the complete setup / advertised choice is missing.
Select a photo in Capture or Browse first.
Back Good marks and phone stars are separate. A back mark is confirmed only after metadata is read again.
This operates on storage in the back. Directories are read again to check the result. Phone preview caches are retained. Existing target names are not overwritten.
The back is synchronized again before writing. If settings changed elsewhere, refresh and review your changes. Success requires a matching readback; this does not release the shutter.
This deletes the original file from the back storage and cannot be undone by this app. A phone preview is not an original-file backup.
User reported successful connection and photo reading on Valeo 22Wi and Aptus 22 (2026-11-11). Other models and firmware still need verification.
Protocol-based ISO, shooting setups and other advertised settings; writes require readback. Hardware write validation is still pending.
The active setup changed since you edited it. Review the refreshed settings and try again.
The back acknowledged the request, but the settings readback did not match. Success was not confirmed.
The selected setup is no longer supplied by this back. Refresh and select again.
The mark readback did not match. The back mark was not confirmed.
Back mark confirmed by metadata readback. Phone star unchanged.
That name already exists on the back. Choose another name or target folder.
Only empty folders can be removed. This folder still contains items.
The refreshed back directory did not confirm the requested change. Check the back and refresh.
Back directory checked after the operation. Phone preview caches are retained.
The clock readback could not be confirmed. Check the time reported by the back.
Default notes did not match the readback. The change was not confirmed.
These defaults apply to future captures. They do not rewrite notes on existing photos.
Use the phone’s current local date and time. No time zone is sent by the original protocol. The back time is read again to verify the change.
For this firmware, a new prefix cannot exceed the current prefix length. The original client allowed at most 23 UTF-16 characters; this is not a firmware byte-size guarantee.
This back did not supply the XMP required by its verified marking path. The mark was not written.
Apply sampled gray balance to photo
The sample no longer belongs to this photo. Take a new gray-balance sample.
The back acknowledged the gray-balance request. A photo preview was requested again; check the image and metadata.
This requests a processed image from the back. The normal cached preview stays separate. Zoom values are the original client levels, not a claim of extra sensor resolution.
X/Y are original-image coordinates in the back protocol after orientation correction. Screen/cropped-preview coordinates are not converted automatically; mapping still needs hardware verification.
Sample gray balance at X/Y for this preview
This photo reply did not include histogram bins.
Exposure values and histogram bins come from the back interface. Their RAW/JPEG origin is not confirmed; they are separate from the phone’s JPEG histogram.
Write the back-provided gray-balance result to this photo, then request metadata and a normal preview again. Check the effect on the back. This is a photo-processing change, not shutter release.
Back histogram bin counts (L / R / G / B when supplied): %1$s
Read this photo from the currently connected back before changing it. Old caches may belong to another back or an earlier app version.
The destination exists, but the source file is still present. A complete move was not confirmed.
The back acknowledged the request. The current state has no verified readback, so it is not shown as confirmed.
This back did not advertise selectable power sources.
These are explicit requests to the back, separate from phone display settings. An Ack confirms receipt, not the actual current state. These actions do not release the shutter.
Changing the power source may interrupt the connection if that source is unavailable. Confirm that the selected source is powered.
Use sampled balance for future captures

Apply the exact sample returned by this back to its active shooting or image-processing setup. Other configuration fields are preserved and read back. This is separate from changing the selected photo.

Manual protocol experiments. Templates distinguish original-client constructions, firmware handlers, fields and research hypotheses. Experiments can bypass normal setting and photo-origin checks. Choose the exact target and values before sending.

Automatic photo requests and configuration refresh pause here. After any experiment is sent, leaving disconnects this session to prevent late replies from contaminating normal commands. Reconnect for ordinary use.
Attachment receive limit: %1$d MiB (phone limit, not a back specification). Change while disconnected, then reconnect. Templates send one header; there is no firmware uploader or automatic fuzzing.

No external wire command was proved for this item. The following action builds a USER HYPOTHESIS using general header syntax; it is not an extracted vendor instruction. Edit the request and interpret every reply or timeout as experimental evidence only.
A named tag waits for that reply; * records the first complete frame without proving causality; empty sends only and waits for no reply. Timeout closes the connection. Encoded header limit: 60 KiB.
The request, encoding or response-matching settings are incomplete or invalid.
Wait for the current transfer or operation to finish before sending an experiment.
This request may change settings, pairing, metadata, calibration or storage. Effects depend on the entered command and firmware and may be persistent.
I confirm the displayed storage target will be erased.

A received Ack or other frame does not prove feature support or that a change took effect. Header previews are limited to 4096 characters; export keeps complete redacted headers, original binary attachments, lengths, SHA-256 and transport logs. Known sensitive header fields are masked; binary attachments are exported unchanged.
